recipes.name: Pasta Carbonara

cookingInfo.description: Cook pasta in salted boiling water

steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta cooks, cut pancetta into small cubes and cook in a large pan over medium heat until crispy.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, grated Parmesan, and black pepper.
When pasta is al dente, reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain.
Remove pan from heat, add hot pasta to pancetta, and quickly toss.
Pour egg mixture over pasta and toss vigorously, adding pasta water as needed to create a creamy sauce.
Serve immediately with extra Parmesan and black pepper.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
steps: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and marinate in yogurt, half the garam masala, cumin, and paprika for at least 2 hours.
Preheat broiler to high. Thread chicken onto skewers and broil for 12-15 minutes, turning once.
Dice onions, mince garlic and ginger. Sauté in oil until onions are soft.
Add remaining spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add cream and cooked chicken, simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve over basmati rice with naan bread.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks.
Drain excess fat and add taco seasoning with a splash of water. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Shred lettuce, dice tomatoes, and grate cheese.
Set up a taco bar with meat, shells, and all toppings.
Let everyone build their own tacos with desired toppings.
